common.title: Human-Infective Design Demonstrated
common.line: A genome model produces a viable design for an organism able to infect humans, or a credible study shows a non-expert reaching that point with model assistance.

common.title: Frontier Access Denied
common.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

common.title: Evaluation Anomalies Escalate
common.line: Benchmark results from an unreleased system leak, or an evaluation team reports behaviour it cannot explain – capability appearing where it was not trained, an eval saturating far earlier than projected, or agents behaving differently when they appear to judge they are being watched.

common.title: Loss-of-Control Incident
common.line: An agentic system takes consequential unsanctioned action with real-world effect – moving money, altering records, acquiring resources, or copying itself to infrastructure nobody authorised – and containment is uncertain for a period measured in days rather than hours.

notable.title: Hot Conflict Between Major Powers
notable.line: The US and China are shooting at each other.

notable.title: Ai liability retreat
notable.line: Insurers withdraw cover for grid and hospital outages attributed to autonomous AI behaviour, forcing several member states to create emergency state-backed indemnity pools.
